title: Our Products
subtitle: A showroom of selected technologies

cards.title: Welcome to the showroom
cards.body:
Here are a few examples from each business unit. Click a pedestal to inspect a product – drag to rotate it – or filter by business unit.

The 3D models are simplified illustrations, not exact product designs.

cards.title: Talking about products
cards.body: Medical device information is regulated. When you talk about our products – inside or outside the company – stick to approved materials, and never suggest uses that are not approved. If in doubt, ask your manager or Regulatory Affairs.

disclaimer: General overview for internal onboarding only – not promotional material. Availability and approved uses differ by country. Product names are trademarks of their respective owners.

products.name: CARTO 3 System
products.what: A 3D mapping and navigation system used during electrophysiology procedures. It builds a live, colour-coded map of the heart's electrical activity and shows where catheters are inside the heart.
products.who: Patients treated for heart rhythm disorders, and the electrophysiologists who treat them.
products.technology: Magnetic and current-based location sensing, signal processing and real-time 3D visualisation.

products.name: VARIPULSE Platform
products.what: A pulsed field ablation system for treating atrial fibrillation. Short, high-energy electrical pulses create lesions that block abnormal electrical signals.
products.who: Patients with atrial fibrillation, where approved.
products.technology: Pulsed electric fields that create lesions without relying on heating or freezing tissue, integrated with 3D mapping.

products.name: Impella heart pumps
products.what: Very small heart pumps inserted through a blood vessel to temporarily support the heart's pumping function.
products.who: Patients whose heart needs temporary support, for example during high-risk procedures or cardiogenic shock.
products.technology: A miniaturised pump delivered by catheter, controlled and monitored from a console.

products.name: Shockwave IVL
products.what: Intravascular lithotripsy catheters that use sound pressure waves to crack calcium in narrowed arteries so they can be opened and treated.
products.who: Patients with calcified coronary or peripheral artery disease.
products.technology: Electrical discharges inside a fluid-filled balloon create sonic pressure waves.

products.name: ECHELON staplers
products.what: Surgical staplers used to cut and seal tissue in procedures such as bariatric, thoracic and colorectal surgery.
products.who: Surgeons and their patients in open and minimally invasive surgery.
products.technology: Controlled tissue compression, staple formation and – in powered versions – motor-driven firing.

products.name: HARMONIC scalpel
products.what: An ultrasonic energy device that cuts and seals blood vessels at the same time.
products.who: Surgeons across many specialties, and their patients.
products.technology: A blade vibrating tens of thousands of times per second; the friction coagulates and cuts tissue.

products.name: VICRYL sutures
products.what: Absorbable sutures used to close wounds and tissue layers. The body gradually absorbs them.
products.who: Surgeons, and patients in almost every type of surgery.
products.technology: A synthetic absorbable polymer (polyglactin 910) that breaks down by hydrolysis.

products.name: MONARCH Platform
products.what: A robotic platform for minimally invasive procedures, for example robotic bronchoscopy to reach and sample hard-to-reach areas of the lung.
products.who: Pulmonologists and urologists, and their patients.
products.technology: Flexible robotics, computer vision and electromagnetic navigation.

products.name: ACUVUE contact lenses
products.what: A family of soft contact lenses for vision correction, including daily disposable and reusable lenses.
products.who: People with refractive errors such as nearsightedness, farsightedness, astigmatism or presbyopia.
products.technology: Hydrogel and silicone-hydrogel materials and precise optical designs.

products.name: TECNIS intraocular lenses
products.what: Artificial lenses implanted during cataract surgery to replace the eye's clouded natural lens.
products.who: Patients having cataract surgery, and their eye surgeons.
products.technology: Optical designs including monofocal, extended depth of focus and multifocal lenses.

products.name: ATTUNE Knee System
products.what: A total knee replacement system of implants and instruments.
products.who: Patients with severe knee arthritis, and orthopaedic surgeons.
products.technology: Implant geometry and materials designed for motion and stability, plus precise instruments.

products.name: VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution
products.what: A robotic-assisted system that helps surgeons plan and carry out knee replacement procedures.
products.who: Orthopaedic surgeons and patients having knee replacement.
products.technology: Robotics, camera-based tracking and data-driven surgical planning.

checkpoint.question: How does Shockwave intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) help open a calcified artery?
options: It uses sound pressure waves to crack the calcium
checkpoint.explanation: IVL creates sonic pressure waves inside a balloon that crack calcium so the vessel can be opened.
